fact: ESCCOM's Notice 5/2026 found EPTC's national backbone an essential facility and ordered EPTC to make it available to Jenny Internet and to share fibre topology with ISPs on non-discriminatory terms, and ordered Jenny to use EPTC backbone connectivity; decision effective 1 July 2026.
The Ministry of ICT confirmed that optical fibre is being rolled out across the country as part of a nationwide deployment; no regions or lengths given. Dated by the article's published date.
Minister of ICT Maziya reported a nationwide rollout of fibre optic cable supported by the World Bank; no regions or lengths given. Dated by the article's published date.
